title: Language Impairment as a Lens onto Large Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2610.28992v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Although large language models (LLMs) encode language in highly distributed spaces, they remain vulnerable to focal disruptions---a phenomenon strikingly similar to how localized brain damage causes clinical aphasia in humans. To investigate this theoretical tension, we ask whether LLMs possess a functional structure analogous to the human language system, by introducing a novel mechanistic interpretability framework inspired by aphasia. Through two complementary approaches, classifier-guided lesioning and continuous activation steering, we systematically induce aphasia-like breakdowns in LLMs. We find that language functions can be successfully isolated to discrete structural circuits and continuous representational vectors, yet these functions remain densely entangled with significant circuit overlap and vector similarities across distinct aphasic profiles. translated_title: 以语言损伤为透镜审视大语言模型
translated_abstract: 尽管大语言模型（LLM）在高度分布式的空间中编码语言，它们仍然容易受到局部性破坏的影响——这一现象与人类大脑局灶性损伤导致临床失语症的情况惊人地相似。为了探究这一理论张力，我们引入了一个受失语症启发的新型机制可解释性框架，以研究大语言模型是否拥有与人类语言系统类似的功能结构。通过两种互补的方法——分类器引导的损伤和连续激活引导——我们系统性地在大语言模型中诱发类似失语症的功能崩溃。我们发现，语言功能可以被成功地隔离到离散的结构性回路和连续的表征向量之中，然而这些功能仍然高度纠缠在一起，在不同的失语特征之间存在着显著的回路重叠和向量相似性。此外，尽管激活引导能够稳健地泛化到下游任务中，但结构性损伤（原文此处截断）……
tldr: 该论文提出了一种受失语症启发的机制可解释性框架，通过分类器引导损伤与连续激活引导两种方法系统性地诱发大语言模型的“失语症”式功能崩溃，揭示了其语言功能既可被隔离到特定回路与表征向量、又彼此高度纠缠的双重特性，为理解大语言模型的功能组织结构提供了全新视角。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces an aphasia-inspired mechanistic interpretability framework that systematically induces aphasia-like breakdowns in LLMs through classifier-guided lesioning and continuous activation steering, revealing that language functions can be isolated into discrete circuits and representational vectors yet remain densely entangled, offering a novel lens onto the functional organization of large language models.
